name: duquant_w4a4_int8_storage
notes: Asymmetric W4A4 on the shared w8a8_int8 GEMM mainloop, exact: weights stored as int8 centred codes (q - z) with an fp32 per-channel scale chosen so fp16(scale*code) reproduces every fake-quant weight; activations stay uint4 codes in int8 lanes and the epilogue applies (acc - z_x[m]*rowsum(c_w)[n]) * s_x * s_w (handles any integer z, including all-positive rows). Pieces in the port overlay.patch: duquant_port/kernels.py (epilogue GEMM, per-token asym A4 code kernel, per-(token,head) asym Q/K/V fake-quant kernel, Triton zigzag gather), duquant_port/int8_runtime.py (fused [q;k;v] and [gate;up] storage, meta-device loader, SDPA with flash when q_len == kv_len). Online block rotations/Hadamard kept in fp32 so codes match the fake-quant runtime bit for bit. Fake-quant 1856 tok/s / 18.5 GB -> 5047 tok/s / 12.05 GB, same PPL. Prefill profile per 2048 tokens (~377 ms): int8 GEMM 118, fp32 rotations 57, lm_head 37, casts 35, attention 23, gather 19. Not vLLM-servable (A4 + online transforms); decode not optimized.
